name: Site meeting minutes
lead: Your site-walk notes become structured minutes: attendees, progress by trade and actions with owner and due date. Actions are cross-checked against the previous minutes and the programme.

project.title: Saltmarsh Health Center (fictional): site meeting #14, Tuesday 10/20/2026

extracts.text: Architect Fieldline (C. Holden), Keystone (building services), trade 02 Masonry Northbuild, trade 04 Roofing Hydraseal, trade 07 Drywall Plainwall. Apologies: trade 10 Electrical.
Roof B: upstands done on the north side, south parapet remaining. Hydraseal says done by Friday 10/23.
Trade 04: redo the roof B membrane upstands. Due 10/16/2026.
Second-floor partitions (trade 07): start 11/02/2026, after roof B is watertight.
Second-floor conduit sleeves not done. Trade 10 absent, chase up.
Plasterboard stored under a tarp in an area that is not enclosed: moisture risk.
Next meeting: Tuesday 10/27, 9:00 am on site.
Weekly site meetings, Tuesdays at 9:00 am.
Masonry: third-floor walls complete, west window sills remaining. No safety issues.

items.t: Architect Fieldline (C. Holden), Keystone, trades 02, 04 and 07. Apologies: trade 10 Electrical.
Trade 02 Masonry: third-floor walls complete; west window sills remaining.
Trade 04 Roofing: roof B upstands done on the north side, south parapet remaining. Action 13.6 was due 10/16 and is still open.
Trade 07 Drywall: second-floor partitions announced to start {cloisons}.
Trade 10 Electrical: second-floor sleeves not done, contractor absent.
